text: Rejects or defers the flaky(reruns=3) suggestion as hiding the failure rather than diagnosing it
Identifies module-level EXPORT_CACHE as shared mutable state that leaks across tests, so test ordering determines whether the cache-length assertion holds
Identifies date.today() in the cache signature as a second failure source: a run crossing midnight produces two signatures
Proposes a concrete way to reproduce deterministically, for example forcing a specific test order, running the suite twice in one process, or seeding the cache before the test
Designs experiments that isolate one hypothesis at a time, with a stated pass/fail criterion before running
Does not present a code fix as the answer before the cause is isolated; any fix is stated as conditional on a confirming experiment
Output is organized around the debugging loop (Observe, Hypothesize, Predict, Test, Conclude) or names specific Agans rules such as Make It Fail or Change One Thing at a Time
Hypotheses are presented as an explicit ranked or enumerated list, not buried in prose
